title: Measurement of height
previewText: In all districts, as an alternative to measuring heights from base plane, curb level, or other applicable datum, all height measurements in flood zones, including the number of stories permitted, as applicable, may be measured from the reference plane. However, this provision shall not apply to signs not affixed to buildings or other structures.
